BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'submission_mode'
          AND data_type = 'smallint'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN submission_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN submission_mode TYPE varchar(32)
            USING CASE submission_mode
                WHEN 1 THEN 'SNAPSHOT'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'ANSWER_PAYLOAD'
                ELSE 'SNAPSHOT'
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET DEFAULT 'SNAPSHOT',
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
